name: auto-list-products
description: Discovery-first product listing for any web admin backend: probe the form once, then crop, fill, verify and submit a batch.

interface.shortDescription: Bulk-list products on any admin backend.
interface.longDescription: Auto-List-Products probes your own admin form once, writes a platform profile, then runs a resumable listing queue: square image crops with blank and carousel-dot guards, fact extraction, optional registration sheet, browser form filling with per-field verification, and an audit pass.
defaultPrompt: Probe my store admin's create form and prepare it for bulk listing.
Crop these product screenshots and build a listing queue.
Audit the products I just submitted for blank images and duplicates.
